verdict: Leads are arriving but not converting — intake is the priority fix.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 175 leads from paid social at a cost per lead of $12.15 — but none of those leads have translated into tracked opportunities or appointments in the CRM. That gap points to an intake and logging issue, not an ads problem. On the paid side, cost per lead rose roughly 18% over the past week while spend stayed flat, a sign that the active campaign is experiencing audience fatigue; ad creative is being refreshed to address this. The most urgent work this week is resolving the CRM pipeline gap so that leads arriving daily are captured, followed up, and counted correctly — expect that to be the focus going into the next period.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days from paid social
cost per lead this period, up ~18% in the most recent week
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks

watch_item.issue: 175 leads arrived this period, but zero opportunities and zero appointments are showing in the pipeline — the leads are real, the intake logging is broken.
watch_item.fix: CRM auto-logging and intake workflow are being corrected now so every incoming lead is captured and visible in the pipeline going forward.
